studyBoundary.name: Dhaka population-grid study extent
studyBoundary.derivation: Atlas bbox [90.25,23.60,90.55,23.95] expanded to whole 1 km UTM46N cells; outer corners exported to WGS84.
limitations: Population-grid study extent only; no DNCC/DSCC boundary match has been established.
Does not represent legal jurisdiction or evacuation zones.
Facility reference is clipped to this grid; legacy river references can lie outside it.
Study boundary must be reviewed against official DNCC/DSCC limits before planning use.

scenarioTypes.label: River flood
scenarioTypes.note: Requires river-station gauge levels and verified danger levels with a matched vertical datum.
scenarioTypes.note_bn: নদীর গেজে পানির স্তর যাচাইকৃত বিপদসীমার সঙ্গে তুলনা করা প্রয়োজন।

scenarioTypes.label: Rainfall waterlogging
scenarioTypes.note: Urban drainage response to intense local rainfall; not a river threshold.
scenarioTypes.note_bn: তীব্র স্থানীয় বৃষ্টিতে শহরের নিষ্কাশন ব্যবস্থার প্রতিক্রিয়া; এটি নদীর বিপদসীমা নয়।

scenarioTypes.label: Compound flood
scenarioTypes.note: Coincident river flood and rainfall waterlogging; requires both evidence streams.
scenarioTypes.note_bn: একই সময়ে নদীর বন্যা ও বৃষ্টিজনিত জলাবদ্ধতা; দুই ধরনের প্রমাণই প্রয়োজন।

note: Registry danger levels are unverified reference values. Point rainfall forecasts do not establish river levels, catchment saturation or flood warnings. Scenario types are classifications only; none establishes a warning, evacuation route or shelter assignment.
